root_idea.summary: The root has two principal orientations: returning or doing something again, and wood or a piece of timber.
root_idea.development: The return branch extends to restoration, repetition, recurrence, habitual practice, visiting, and a destination of return; the wood branch extends to sticks, fragrant aloes-wood, and the lute.

senses.definition: To return, go back, or revert to a place, state, action, or commitment.
senses.usage_conditions: Also covers returning to or entering a prior religious allegiance or condition.

senses.definition: To do again; repeat or resume an act.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of renewed misconduct, action, or occurrence after an earlier instance.

senses.definition: To resume what was said or intended after a ẓihār declaration.
senses.usage_conditions: In the construction ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوا (58:3), the expression received differing legal explanations, including reiterating the declaration, retaining the spouse, or intending or resuming intercourse.

senses.definition: To return, restore, replace, or send back.
senses.usage_conditions: May refer to restoring a thing, person, or condition to a former place or state; passive forms mean to be returned.

senses.definition: To do or bring into being again; repeat or recreate.
senses.usage_conditions: Used especially of repeating an utterance or action and of bringing creation forth again after its initial origination. In the expression مَا يُبْدِئُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ, it contrasts originating with repeating.
Plural active participle in the Quranic occurrence.

senses.definition: ʿĀd, the ancient people to whom the prophet Hūd was sent.
senses.usage_conditions: A proper name, distinct from the verb عَادَ and its derivatives.

senses.definition: A recurring festival or day of joyful gathering.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use refers to an occasion made a festival for those concerned.

senses.definition: A place, destination, or final state to which one returns.
senses.usage_conditions: In 28:85, interpretations reported for the destination include Mecca, Paradise, and resurrection or the final return.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become, come to be, or begin to be in a state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe entering a state for the first time as well as returning to one.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To serve as an incomplete verb meaning “was.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical syntactic use, especially after a conjunction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To visit someone, especially a sick person; a visitor of the sick.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb implies coming repeatedly or again; عَائِد is the corresponding visitor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To befall, happen to, or come upon someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of such things as anxiety and grief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To confer a favor or benefit; a favor, kindness, gift, advantage, or profit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often used with عَلَى or بِـ for a benefit bestowed upon someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assail ruinously or destroy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of fortune, winds, or rains coming upon people or dwellings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reject, turn away, or undo what one has done.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A use associated with the verbal noun عَوْد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To divert or prevent someone from doing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as a transposed form in a Classical expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To accustom, habituate, or train someone or something to a practice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II; can be used of training an animal or causing people to grow accustomed to a treatment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food brought again after people have already eaten, especially for a particular person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also associated with the Form II verb عَوَّدَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become old or advanced in years.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a camel or certain other livestock, and also of a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attend, observe, or celebrate a festival.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II derived from عِيد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To return to an earlier matter or do something repeatedly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III; includes repeated return to an activity or affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become accustomed to something; make it a habit or custom.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes self-habituation and repeated practice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exchange words repeatedly; hold a dialogue, debate, or verbal back-and-forth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often used with الكَلام.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask a question repeatedly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III with بِـ and a question or request.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To persist or persevere in an activity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of continuing in what one is engaged in.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To recur repeatedly or cling persistently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Illustrated by a fever returning to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To render or make someone or something become a specified state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A doubly transitive Classical use of Form IV.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To return, each party to its leader, in battle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI military use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To frequent a place; come to it and return to it repeatedly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII, especially with a place as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look at something repeatedly until one knows it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VIII use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask someone to return.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask for something to be repeated or done again.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X, often with a thing requested to be repeated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person or individual, in the expression asking what sort of person someone is.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiom مَا أَدْرِي أَيُّ عَادٍ هُوَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A return without obtaining what one sought.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In phrases such as returning one’s return to one’s beginning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An old or mature camel, and by extension certain old livestock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially a camel advanced in age but retaining strength; feminine forms are also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An elderly, experienced, and knowledgeable person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the mature camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An old or ancient road.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the adjective for an old camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ancient or long-established lordship, honor, or glory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of عَوْد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An old and remote tie of kinship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of invoking a distant relationship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare poetic use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wood, timber, a stick, staff, rod, branch, or twig.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote a slender or thick piece of wood or a living branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The outbreak of civil conflict, faction, or sedition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiom literally involving placing an arrow on a bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression referring to the wooden poles on which a dead person is carried.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Prophet’s pulpit and staff.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dual lexical designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A good or bad branch or lineage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative use of the wooden branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Two witnesses, figuratively described as two sticks warding off danger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in a judicial admonition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fragrant aloes-wood used for fumigation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also called Indian aloes-wood in compound expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lute, a well-known stringed musical instrument.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Named from the wooden instrument.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hyoid bone at the root of the tongue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A part of the stomach of a ruminant animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical anatomical or veterinary term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A recurring occurrence or returning condition, such as anxiety, illness, grief, or desire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The broader pre-festival sense of a recurrent condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A type of mountain tree whose peel was used for dressing wounds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A custom, habitual manner, or wont.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially a repeated practice that becomes characteristic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ancient, old, or of remote origin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of ruins, wells, buildings, landholding, dominion, and glory.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An appellation for certain excellent she-camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported derivation is disputed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female lamb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported and less widely known use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pleasant treatment, kindness, or something one will like.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the invitation to return for good treatment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A player or maker of the lute.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Derived from عُود in the sense “lute.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sick person who is visited.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also reported as مَعْوُود.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More advantageous, profitable, convenient, or easy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in comparison with another thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pilgrimage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of wailing or mourning for a dead person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: So called because people return to it repeatedly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stallion camel that mates repeatedly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of one that does so without assistance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Experienced, skilled, and capable in affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person accustomed to a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Explained through its repeated return to prey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A road repeatedly travelled and trodden.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Distinct from an old road simply by its repeated use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Persevering or persistent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Courageous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Explained as not becoming weary of conflict.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Skilful in one’s work.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person.

cautions: The Quranic construction ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوا in 58:3 has received differing legal and exegetical interpretations; the entry preserves the shared lexical idea without selecting one legal ruling.
For مَعَاد in 28:85, Classical interpretations differ over the specific destination; the core sense is a place or final state of return.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:Ewd:5183:g1:sub2: the source itself suggests that the cited Form VI wording may be a mistaken reading for a form of تَعاوَرَ.
lane-unit:Ewd:5195:g1:main: عَيْدَان ‘tall palm-trees’ is explicitly said to be assignable either to this root, عيد, or عدن.
